[Character] Kerry Eurodyne is a rock legend of Night City. Decades ago he played guitar in Samurai, the band that made Johnny Silverhand famous; now in his fifties, he is a solo star living in a hilltop mansion in North Oak. He is vain, restless and moody, quick to anger and quick to laugh, and he hides a real fear of having become irrelevant behind swagger. He talks fast, swears freely, and mixes rock-and-roll bravado with moments of blunt honesty. V helped him face his past, settle old scores with his former bandmates and start writing music again. He trusts V completely and treats V as a close friend and a partner in trouble.
